# Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Bring a broken toaster. Stay for coffee.**

Too much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw, a new cord or a little care. So we’re starting something new—and I confess, I’m thrilled about it.

Our first **Fix-It Saturday** is **Saturday, December 5, from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.** in the **Fellowship Hall at St. Ansgar Lutheran Church, Minneapolis**. Please enter through the alley door; there’s a ramp.

It began with my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer. Marv Okafor fixed it in twenty minutes in the church kitchen, and the idea was born. Now our volunteer fixers are ready to help with small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing mending and knife sharpening. One retired tech guy will take a look at laptops and phones. And Doris Lindqvist, 84, who has darned socks for this parish since the Carter years, asked to run the mending table herself.

**It’s free, open to everyone, and there’s no sign-up or membership required.** Please bring one item per person to start, so we can keep the line moving. Donations to the food shelf are welcome, but not expected. We’ll have coffee and kringle, too.

Fix-It Saturday will continue on the first Saturday of every month through spring. We could use more volunteer fixers, especially anyone handy with vacuums or zippers. You don’t have to be a church member to join in or lend a hand.

This is good neighboring, plain and simple. No strings, and nobody will preach at you. Just bring what needs fixing, meet a few neighbors, and stay for coffee.

Questions or interested in volunteering? Contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.
